fs_hz.label: Resonant frequency
fs_hz.help: Frequency at which the cone resonates in free air, without a box.

qts.label: Total Q
qts.help: Total damping of the driver at resonance; combines electrical and mechanical losses.

qes.label: Electrical Q
qes.help: Share of the damping that comes from the motor (voice coil and magnet).

qms.label: Mechanical Q
qms.help: Share of the damping that comes from the suspension (spider and surround).

vas_m3.label: Equivalent volume
vas_m3.help: Volume of air with the same stiffness as the cone suspension.

re_ohm.label: Coil resistance
re_ohm.help: Electrical resistance of the voice coil measured at DC.

le_h.label: Coil inductance
le_h.help: Inductance of the voice coil, which reduces the response at high frequencies.

xmax_m.label: Maximum excursion
xmax_m.help: Largest one-way cone displacement that still behaves linearly.

sd_m2.label: Cone area
sd_m2.help: Effective area that moves air, usually including half of the surround.

pe_w.label: Thermal power
pe_w.help: Power the driver handles continuously without overheating.

bl_tm.label: Force factor
bl_tm.help: Motor strength: magnetic field times the length of wire in the coil.

mms_kg.label: Moving mass
mms_kg.help: Mass of the moving assembly, including the air it carries.

vb_m3.label: Box volume
vb_m3.help: Gross internal box volume; driver and port volumes are subtracted in the calculation.

vr_m3.label: Rear chamber volume (sealed)
vr_m3.help: Gross volume of the sealed chamber behind the cone, before subtracting the driver.

vf_m3.label: Front chamber volume (ported)
vf_m3.help: Gross volume of the chamber in front of the cone, where the port is, before subtracting the port.

fb_hz.label: Port tuning
fb_hz.help: Frequency at which the port and the box volume resonate together.

vd_m3.label: Driver displacement
vd_m3.help: Volume the driver itself occupies inside the box (datasheet). Leave 0 if unknown.

ql.label: Box losses (Ql)
ql.help: Leakage and absorption losses. 7 is typical for a well-sealed box; lower means more loss.

diameter_m.label: Port diameter
diameter_m.help: Inner diameter of each round port.

width_m.label: Port width
width_m.help: Inner width of each rectangular port.

height_m.label: Port height
height_m.help: Inner height of each rectangular or triangular port.

base_m.label: Port base
base_m.help: Inner base of each triangular port.

port_count.label: Number of ports
port_count.help: Number of identical ports in the box.

driver_count.label: Number of drivers
driver_count.help: Number of identical drivers in the same box.

power_w.label: Input power
power_w.help: Electrical power applied to the set, referred to the resistance Re.

voltage_v.label: Input voltage
voltage_v.help: RMS voltage applied to the set's terminals.
